guide.project_name.example: use lowercase words joined by dashes, like {example}
guide.project_name.rule: A name is lowercase letters and digits, with words joined by single dashes, and it starts with a letter: it becomes a folder, a package name and an import name.
guide.toggle_exclusive.replaces: {value} replaces {dropped}: only one {group} fits a project. Untick {value} to get it back.
guide.what_is.stack: stack = the set of tools one project is built with: its language, tests, lint and build.
guide.what_is.slice: A slice is a folder that holds one outcome of a program, with files named for the role they play. vertical-slices checks that layout.
guide.what_is.plugin: plugin = a program that teaches smith something: a language, a test runner, a layout rule, a deploy target.
guide.what_is.recipe: recipe = a file that says how every new project is made, so a team makes them all the same way.
